# Petdex

> Open-source index and native desktop companion ecosystem of animated pixel pets for coding agents. Created by Railly Hugo at Crafter Station.

- Canonical site: https://petdex.dev
- Source code: https://github.com/crafter-station/petdex
- Creator: Railly Hugo (https://railly.dev, https://github.com/Railly, https://x.com/raillyhugo)
- Studio: Crafter Station (https://crafter.run, https://github.com/crafter-station)

## Quick install

- CLI: `npx petdex install boba`
- Native Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux): https://petdex.dev/download

## Supported coding agents

Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Qoder, Kimi Code, CodeBuddy, OMP, Hermes, and DeepSeek Harness.

## Key pages

- [Home & Pet Gallery](https://petdex.dev/): browse and search animated pixel pets by kind, vibe, color, and collection.
- [Download Petdex Desktop](https://petdex.dev/download): native desktop companion for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- [Collections](https://petdex.dev/collections): curated and franchise pet collections.
- [Built With Petdex](https://petdex.dev/built-with): community apps, wellness tools, wearables, and SDKs built on Petdex.
- [Brand Kit](https://petdex.dev/brand): Pocket Toy brand identity, colors, and typography.
- [Logo System](https://petdex.dev/brand/logo-system): 64x64 pixel construction grid, clearspace, lockups, and bilingual `Petdex · 宠物图鉴` usage.
- [Brand Assets](https://petdex.dev/brand/brand-assets): official tactile SVG/PNG marks, monochrome variants, and embed snippets.
- [Docs](https://petdex.dev/docs): CLI, desktop, and submission documentation.
- [About](https://petdex.dev/about): project story, FAQ, and open-source licensing notes.
